name: bubble-field
title: Bubble Field
description: Bubble scatter on log-log axes — position for two counts, bubble area for a third, color for category.
question: How do entities spread across two count dimensions, and which are the heavyweights?
whenToUse: Positioning a dozen-odd named entities on two count metrics that span several orders of magnitude, with a third count as bubble size.
antiUse: Log-log count data spanning decades only — not linear data; skip it for narrow ranges, negative/zero values, or a single dimension.
props: points: {x, y, size, label, series, color?}[]; xLabel; yLabel; legendUnit? (color defaults to seriesColor by series index)
